tasks.AveragePagesPerDay: Divide the remaining pages by the number of days left to find the average number of pages Solo needs to read per day.
tasks.PagesAlreadyRead: Determine how many pages Solo has already read on Monday.
tasks.RemainingPages: Subtract the number of pages already read from the total pages to find out how many pages are left to be read.
tasks.TotalPagesToRead: Calculate the total number of pages Solo needs to read from all textbooks.
